summary: Kitchen has visible cutting hazards on the counter edge and items near the cooktop.

hazards.title: Exposed knife on counter edge
hazards.detail: Knife handle and blade are resting near the counter edge, risking drops or cuts.
fixSteps: Store the knife safely in a block, sheath, or drawer tray.
Keep sharp utensils well away from countertop edges.

hazards.title: Towel hung on oven door handle
hazards.detail: Cloth towel hangs on the oven handle near heating elements, posing a fire risk.
fixSteps: Relocate kitchen towels away from cooking heat sources.
Hang towels on dedicated hooks or drawer pulls away from the stove.

hazards.title: Cord near sink splash zone
hazards.detail: Appliance power cord sits in close proximity to the kitchen sink water source.
fixSteps: Move countertop appliances further from the sink perimeter.
Ensure power outlet is protected with an operational GFCI receptacle.
